rationale: The native DF-CCSD(T) owner may preconverge a detached density with a separately bundled H/C JK-fit basis for neutral spherical through-f cold references. Admission excludes cache-eligible exact references, requires a conservative dense Cartesian/fitting sweep-volume amortization screen, charges actual preparation metadata/matrices under the finite cap, and requires the shared source-backed dense/packed planner to retain full factors with metadata and DIIS reservations; there is no fixed AO interval. Streamed proposals are skipped because bounded memory does not imply profitable work. The volume screen is a heuristic, not a universal measured crossover or actual integral census. The accepted RHF reference, Hamiltonian and complete analytic response remain unscreened FP64 Direct. Preliminary work is finite and included in reference/endpoint timing; unsupported topology, tight budgets and refused guesses retain Direct. Explicit or warm density seeds take precedence.
revisit_condition: Expand the topology/resource domain only with independent reference/force gates and paired complete endpoint evidence, including a larger planner case. Never interpret this policy as promotion of a fitted accepted reference or DF-HF gradients.
